title: Evidence Content Addressing
intent: Address evidence by verified content digest rather than mutable location.
problem: Without SHA-256 digest indexes immutable evidence bytes, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the evidence content addressing contract.
context: This pattern addresses review depends on exact captured material; its concrete control is SHA-256 digest indexes immutable evidence bytes.
forces: Correctness requires that retrieved bytes reproduce the recorded digest
Operational pressure can cause: mutable files change behind a stable path
solution: Implement SHA-256 digest indexes immutable evidence bytes. Verify the anchored symbol `EvidenceVaultError` with `test_store_returns_opaque_content_addressed_metadata_without_raw_content` before reuse.
invariants: retrieved bytes reproduce the recorded digest
different content cannot reuse an evidence identity
failure_modes: mutable files change behind a stable path
digest metadata is trusted without byte verification
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `mutable files change behind a stable path` and fails closed if the evidence content addressing evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For evidence content addressing, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to SHA-256 digest indexes immutable evidence bytes.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: review depends on exact captured material
Do not apply when: only a live external state observation matters
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: review depends on exact captured material
not_when: only a live external state observation matters
